title: Enable Salesforce as an identity provider
when: The step asks to switch on the org's Identity Provider feature and choose which certificate signs its SAML assertions. It is not creating a connected app, not configuring single sign-on into Salesforce, and not creating the certificate itself.
steps: In the embedded Identity Provider page, click 'Enable Identity Provider'.
Choose the certificate the step names in the certificate dropdown.
Click Save, and confirm if asked.
doneWhen: The Identity Provider page shows the provider as enabled, with the chosen certificate and a Download Metadata button.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 5 actions, 22 s, reviewer confirmed, held in a fresh session. Confirmed without any model: the Setup Audit Trail recorded 'Changed the Identity Provider Certificate from null to Autopilot Trial Cert'.

trial.step: Enable Salesforce as an identity provider, signing with the certificate Autopilot Trial Cert.

notes: Needs the certificate to exist first: see certificate-create-self-signed.
